verdict.rationale: PayPal's agentic commerce plugs into multi-party protocols: ACP, used for ChatGPT/OpenAI checkout, and Google's UCP, used for AI Mode/Gemini. Its docs also name several independent catalog partners that connect to its services: Wix, Cymbio, BigCommerce/Feedonomics and Shopware. Together these show more than two parties beyond PayPal implementing the surrounding protocols and platform. All of this is vendor-claimed, and PayPal's own Store Sync cart API is a proprietary, form-gated reverse API that PayPal's own service calls. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that the named partners have live implementations, and evidence that third parties implement PayPal's own cart/Store Sync protocol rather than just feeding into it.
